title: Nathanael Under the Fig Tree
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus said to a man named Philip, “Follow Me.” Philip did, and he hurried to find his friend Nathanael.
“We have found Him!” said Philip. “He is the One the prophets wrote about. He is Jesus from Nazareth.”
Nathanael was not sure. “Can anything good come out of Nazareth?” he asked. Philip did not argue. He just said, “Come and see.”
p2: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming, He said, “Here is an honest man.” Nathanael was surprised. “How do You know me?” Jesus said, “I saw you under the fig tree, before Philip called you.”
Nathanael’s doubt turned to belief. He said, “Teacher, You are the Son of God!” Jesus knows you too, even when you are alone. Tonight, tell Him what is in your heart.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
